srList.sentence: A total of 336 patients with de novo PD within 3 year of diagnosis and without the use of dopaminergic medications at enrollment were randomized to either isradipine (n = 170) or placebo (n = 166). 12 Although most patients enrolled on no medication, they were allowed to receive amantadine (n = 26) or anticholinergic agents (n = 5) if on stable doses at the time of study entry.

srList.sentence: The STEADY-PD III was a 36-month, multicenter, randomized, parallel-group, placebo-controlled phase 3 study of the efficacy of isradipine in early-stage PD.

srList.sentence: Patients and Methods Study Population Longitudinal data on the 33 items of the MDS-UPDRS Part 3 Motor Examination performed in the STEADY-PD III study (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02168842) were used to illustrate the proposed techniques.
